args.content:
import re

def slugify(text: str) -> str:
    """Convert arbitrary text into a lowercase URL-safe kebab-case slug.

    Args:
        text: Input string to normalize.

    Returns:
        Normalized kebab-case slug containing only `[a-z0-9-]`.
    """
    cleaned = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text.strip().lower())
    return cleaned.strip('-')
